title: Qwen3-Coder-Next Technical Report
authors_zh: Ruisheng Cao、Mouxiang Chen、Jiawei Chen、Zeyu Cui、Yunlong Feng、Binyuan Hui、Yuheng Jing、Kaixin Li、Mingze Li、Junyang Lin、Zeyao Ma、Kashun Shum、Xuwu Wang、Jinxi Wei、Jiaxi Yang、Jiajun Zhang、Lei Zhang、Zongmeng Zhang、Wenting Zhao、Fan Zhou
paper_type_zh: 前沿编码智能体技术报告与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 关注可执行软件工程任务、agentic RL 反馈、reward-hacking 控制和复现审计的研究者
one_line: Qwen3-Coder-Next discloses executable coding-task synthesis and Docker-based verification with staged agentic training, but not its training tasks, environments, trajectories, or audit records.
Qwen3-Coder-Next 披露了可执行编码任务合成、Docker 验证和分阶段 agentic training，但未发布训练任务、环境、轨迹或审计记录。
why: It separates released weights and inference code from partially disclosed task provenance, verification, data rights, and reproducibility evidence.
inclusion_reason: A frontier coding-agent report that discloses executable task construction, environment feedback, filtering, reward-hacking controls, and material unreleased audit boundaries.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Coding-agent reports can describe runnable repositories, unit tests, tool trajectories, and reinforcement learning while leaving readers unable to identify the concrete tasks, source revisions, images, test generators, rejected records, and reward rules that created the claimed supervision. In software engineering, a task is not fully specified by an issue and patch alone: repository state, dependencies, test harness, remote access, and terminal conditions also affect what an agent can learn and how a result can be gamed.

Qwen3-Coder-Next provides substantial but partial information about executable task construction and agentic training. It names GitHub pull requests, open and proprietary sources, synthetic repository changes, Docker environments, and multiple feedback mechanisms, while withholding the training tasks, environments, trajectories, audit logs, and full provenance. This Card records the disclosed data and feedback contracts without treating released weights or inference code as an open training-data recipe.

编码智能体报告可能描述可运行仓库、单元测试、工具轨迹和强化学习，却让读者无法识别构成所称监督的具体任务、来源版本、镜像、测试生成器、拒绝记录和 reward 规则。在软件工程中，一个任务并不只由 issue 和 patch 定义：仓库状态、依赖、测试 harness、远程访问和终止条件也会影响智能体能学到什么，以及结果如何被投机利用。

Qwen3-Coder-Next 对可执行任务构建和 agentic training 提供了较多但不完整的信息。它点名 GitHub pull request、开放与专有来源、合成仓库改动、Docker 环境和多种反馈机制，却保留了训练任务、环境、轨迹、审计日志和完整 provenance。本卡片记录已披露的数据与反馈契约，而不把发布的权重或推理代码视作开放训练数据配方。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The report builds executable software-engineering supervision from pull requests and synthetic repository changes. A task can include a buggy repository state, a fix, a test patch, a Docker environment, a verification script, and eventually a multi-turn tool trajectory. This turns code-agent training from static answer prediction into interaction with a task-specific execution substrate.

The feedback contract is mixed. It includes execution scripts, majority-consensus synthesized unit tests, Mini-SWE-agent verification, a multidimensional pairwise judge, terminal completion reward, and penalties for unfinished rollouts or invalid tool format. The report then describes staged mid-training, SFT, domain-expert training, distillation, single-turn execution RL, and multi-turn agentic RL.

For the disclosure ledger, the key value is a visible construction and verification outline together with explicit non-release boundaries. It is not a publication of the underlying task corpus, container images, verification logs, reward implementation, or the full production training schedule.

报告从 pull request 和合成仓库改动构建可执行的软件工程监督。一个任务可包含有缺陷的仓库状态、修复、测试 patch、Docker 环境、验证脚本，以及最终的多轮工具轨迹。这使代码智能体训练从静态答案预测转为与任务专属执行基底交互。

反馈契约是混合的，包括执行脚本、多数共识保留的合成单元测试、Mini-SWE-agent 验证、多维成对 judge、终止完成 reward，以及对未完成 rollout 或无效工具格式的惩罚。报告随后描述了分阶段的中期训练、SFT、领域专家训练、蒸馏、单轮执行 RL 和多轮 agentic RL。

从披露账本看，关键价值在于可见的构建与验证轮廓，以及明确的未发布边界。它不是对底层任务语料、容器镜像、验证日志、reward 实现或完整生产训练日程的发布。

title: Method
方法
html:
The report uses Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Base and names Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct for several web, QA, and trajectory operations. It mines issue-related pull requests into buggy-state, fix, and test triples, builds runnable environments, and synthesizes bugs or issues by rewriting and perturbing repositories. Multiple agent frameworks generate multi-turn trajectories; exact framework configurations and environment/test-generation component identities are incomplete.

Prompt sources include GitHub code and pull requests, existing open-source software-engineering datasets, Common Crawl or domain web, proprietary SFT corpora, documentation QA, synthetic repository tasks, and generated coding-agent tasks. The report says it has about 600B repository-level mid-training tokens, about 800k synthetic verifiable software-engineering tasks, and 807,693 PR-derived repository instances. It provides no source manifests, source proportions, repository revision list, or task and trajectory release.

Runnable Docker environments and verification scripts are evaluated or rolled out through MegaFlow on Kubernetes. Candidate unit tests are retained by majority consensus across independently generated solutions. Filters remove benchmark overlap, require distinct buggy and fixed execution, and reject nonfunctional verifiers, ambiguous tasks, inconsistent environments, misaligned tests, malformed trajectories, and easy or noisy RL instances. Mixture weights, decoding, rollout allocation, exact thresholds, reward coefficients, and schedules are undisclosed.

报告使用 Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Base，并将 Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct 用于若干网页、QA 和轨迹操作。它将与 issue 相关的 pull request 挖掘为缺陷状态、修复和测试三元组，构建可运行环境，并通过重写和扰动仓库来合成 bug 或 issue。多个 agent framework 生成多轮轨迹；精确 framework 配置以及环境/测试生成组件身份披露不完整。

prompt 来源包括 GitHub 代码和 pull request、现有开源软件工程数据集、Common Crawl 或领域网页、专有 SFT 语料、文档 QA、合成仓库任务和生成的编码智能体任务。报告称拥有约 600B 仓库级中期训练 token、约 80 万个合成可验证软件工程任务，以及 807,693 个 PR 派生仓库实例。它没有提供来源 manifest、来源比例、仓库版本列表或任务与轨迹发布。

可运行 Docker 环境和验证脚本通过 Kubernetes 上的 MegaFlow 进行评估或 rollout。候选单元测试由独立生成解之间的多数共识保留。过滤器移除 benchmark 重叠，要求有差异的缺陷/修复执行，并拒绝失效 verifier、歧义任务、不一致环境、错位测试、畸形轨迹以及简单或噪声 RL 实例。混合权重、解码、rollout 分配、精确阈值、reward 系数和日程未披露。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official arXiv report states approximately 800k synthetic verifiable software-engineering tasks and 807,693 pull-request-derived repository instances. It also reports about 600B repository-level mid-training tokens. These are construction or training-scale statements, not a released manifest of distinct tasks, revisions, containers, trajectories, or records.

The report supports recording majority-consensus synthesized tests, execution verification, completion and format penalties, and a response to git or network reward hacking. It also says SFT and RL prompts are disjoint and describes removal of downstream-benchmark overlap and evaluation remotes, branches, or tags. The report does not disclose the methods, thresholds, benchmarks, residual-overlap results, or logs required to independently evaluate those controls.

The official QwenLM repository and Qwen model release are available, while no official training-task, Docker-image, trajectory, verifier-data, or filter-log release is identified. The evidence therefore supports a partial-disclosure model report, not a reusable executable-task dataset or fully auditable agent-RL recipe.

官方 arXiv 报告称有约 80 万个合成可验证软件工程任务和 807,693 个 pull-request 派生的仓库实例，还报告了约 600B 仓库级中期训练 token。这些是构建或训练规模陈述，不是已发布的不同任务、版本、容器、轨迹或记录 manifest。

报告支持记录多数共识合成测试、执行验证、完成与格式惩罚，以及对 git 或网络 reward hacking 的应对。它还称 SFT 与 RL prompt 不重叠，并描述了移除下游 benchmark 重叠以及评估 remote、branch 或 tag。报告没有披露独立评估这些控制所需的方法、阈值、benchmark、残余重叠结果或日志。

官方 QwenLM 仓库和 Qwen 模型发布可用，但未找到官方训练任务、Docker 镜像、轨迹、verifier 数据或过滤日志发布。因此，证据支持部分披露的模型报告，而不是可复用的可执行任务数据集或完全可审计的 agent-RL 配方。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The report makes an executable-task pipeline unusually visible for a frontier coding-agent release. It separates buggy and fixed repository states, tests, Docker environments, verification scripts, and trajectories, rather than treating a code issue and a final patch as the whole data object. Its combination of test synthesis, execution checks, pairwise judgment, completion reward, and format penalties also exposes multiple feedback layers.

For this atlas, the novel contribution is a detailed partial disclosure of how repository tasks may be constructed and defended against reward shortcuts. The value is evidentiary rather than a claim that the described pipeline is open, fully calibrated, or independently reproducible.

对前沿编码智能体发布而言，该报告使可执行任务管线异常可见。它区分缺陷与修复后的仓库状态、测试、Docker 环境、验证脚本和轨迹，而不是把代码 issue 与最终 patch 当作全部数据对象。它结合测试合成、执行检查、成对判断、完成 reward 和格式惩罚，也揭示了多个反馈层。

对本图谱而言，新贡献是对仓库任务如何构建以及如何防范 reward 快捷路径的详细部分披露。其价值在于证据，而不是声称所述管线已开放、完全校准或可由外部独立复现。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
No official release is pinned for the training tasks, trajectories, Docker images, verifier data, rejected records, environment manifests, or audit logs. The report names source classes but not source inventories, rights, mixture weights, repository revisions, prompts, generated-data lineage, or image digests. Apache-2.0 applies to the released weights, not necessarily to GitHub, web, proprietary, synthetic, or trajectory materials.

Execution tests can be superficial, nonfunctional, misaligned, or vulnerable to hidden solution recovery. The report describes controls for git or network reward hacking, but their exact blocker rules, scope, and error analysis are unavailable. Terminal completion also does not prove that all intermediate tool use was sound, and cross-scaffold transfer is only partially characterized.

The stated SFT/RL prompt disjointness and overlap-removal procedures lack public splits, benchmark lists, thresholds, residual-overlap results, and reproducible logs. As a result, the reported executable-task scale, verification structure, and RL stages should not be taken as evidence of a public or independently auditable training corpus.

没有官方发布训练任务、轨迹、Docker 镜像、verifier 数据、拒绝记录、环境 manifest 或审计日志。报告点名了来源类别，却未提供来源清单、权利、混合权重、仓库版本、prompt、生成数据 lineage 或镜像 digest。Apache-2.0 适用于发布的权重，但未必适用于 GitHub、网页、专有、合成或轨迹材料。

执行测试可能肤浅、失效、错位，或容易通过恢复隐藏解来规避。报告描述了针对 git 或网络 reward hacking 的控制，但其精确阻断规则、范围和错误分析不可用。终止完成也不能证明所有中间工具使用均可靠，跨 scaffold 迁移也只得到部分刻画。

所称的 SFT/RL prompt 不重叠和重叠移除程序没有公开切分、benchmark 列表、阈值、残余重叠结果和可复现日志。因此，报告中的可执行任务规模、验证结构和 RL 阶段不应被视为公开或可独立审计训练语料的证据。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
This report is useful as a checklist for executable software-engineering data: record repository state, patch, test, dependencies, container image, verifier behavior, tool observation, terminal rule, and reward penalties separately. It also makes clear why a task count or a released model does not substitute for task manifests, revision lineage, and test or environment release.

For agentic RL, it illustrates how execution signals, pairwise judgments, completion reward, and formatting constraints can coexist. Researchers evaluating similar pipelines should request environment snapshots, verifier error analysis, train/evaluation separation, residual-overlap audits, rejected-trajectory logs, and explicit defenses against git and network reward shortcuts before treating results as reproducible evidence.

该报告可作为可执行软件工程数据的检查清单：分别记录仓库状态、patch、测试、依赖、容器镜像、verifier 行为、工具观察、终止规则和 reward 惩罚。它也表明，任务数量或发布模型不能替代任务 manifest、版本 lineage 以及测试或环境发布。

对 agentic RL，它说明执行信号、成对判断、完成 reward 和格式约束可以同时存在。评估类似管线的研究者应要求环境快照、verifier 错误分析、训练/评估隔离、残余重叠审计、拒绝轨迹日志，以及对 git 和网络 reward 快捷路径的明确防御，然后再把结果当作可复现证据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Separate the reported task counts from released task, revision, image, and trajectory artifacts; no such corpus release is pinned.
  • Model an executable task as repository state plus patch, tests, dependencies, container, verifier, and terminal rule.
  • Treat majority-consensus tests and Mini-SWE-agent verification as named mechanisms with unknown calibration and logs.
  • Read git and network protections as reward-hacking controls whose implementation and error rates remain undisclosed.
  • Keep Track 12's disclosure analysis separate from a Track 8 classification of the report as a reusable RL recipe.

• 将报告的任务数量与已发布的任务、版本、镜像和轨迹 artifact 分开；目前未固定任何此类语料发布。
  • 将可执行任务建模为仓库状态加 patch、测试、依赖、容器、verifier 和终止规则。
  • 将多数共识测试和 Mini-SWE-agent 验证视为已命名但校准与日志 unknown 的机制。
  • 将 git 和网络保护解读为 reward-hacking 控制，其实现与错误率仍未披露。
  • 将 Track 12 的披露分析与把报告归类为可复用 RL 配方的 Track 8 分类保持区分。
